verdict.rationale: Bulk operations, such as batch payouts or bulk refunds, are a fair axis for a payments API platform, so the story applies. The evidence pack only documents single-item operations: creating individual payments, payouts, payment links and mandate payments. Console reporting and per-event webhooks are adjacent features, not bulk actions across many items, and no batch endpoint or bulk tool (including via the MCP server) is evidenced.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
